title: Observability sync: tracing & cost telemetry round-up (week of 2026-02-16)
content:
Attendees: Ava (chair), Samir, Li, Janelle, Omar, Maya (joined for cost section)

Purpose: Weekly sync to capture short term priorities for tracing, dashboard housekeeping, and cost telemetry noise reductions. Focus this week on two concrete migrations: (1) move slow queries dashboard to new panel model and (2) roll out trace-sampler v2 to reduce high-cardinality span blowups.

Summary/Highlights:
- Tracing: We validated trace-sampler v2 in the staging cluster (sampler changes: dynamic tail-sampling + regex-based tag exclusion). Initial results: 45% reduction in unique span keys across service-redwood-api; tail latency traces preserved for p99 regressions.
- Dashboards: Migration plan for slow-ops dashboard drafted. New design consolidates 6 cards into 3 summary cards + 3 detail overlays to improve load time; expected rendering improvement ~30% on low-spec browsers.
- Cost telemetry: Identified a recurring spike in ingestion costs correlated with a bad actor job that emits high-cardinality metrics every 5m. Temporary kill-switch reduced ingestion by ~18%.

Detailed notes:
1) Tracing: sampler rollout
   - Staging run (2026-02-18): sampler v2 applied to services: redwood-api, router, request-proxy.
   - Metrics observed: unique-span-keys reduced from 1.8M/day -> 1.0M/day (sample window).
   - Action: broaden regex exclusions to drop user.session_id and request.client_ip from span tags at source.
   - Blocker: One third-party client library annotates spans with full request bodies under tag "payload"; need a targeted instrumentation PR.
   - Owners: Samir to open PR to add tag scrubber (due 2026-02-24). Li to produce a short compatibility note for Solutions Eng (due 2026-02-22).

2) Dashboards: slow-ops & SLO panels
   - Problem: slow-ops dashboard has 12 queries with heavy joins causing 4–6s load times during spikes.
   - Proposal: pre-aggregate 1m rollups in metrics-store; replace on-the-fly joins with direct counters.
   - Risk: rollups may lose histogram granularity for pX buckets; mitigation: keep raw histograms for 1h hot window.
   - Work items: Janelle to draft migration runbook (includes rollback steps) by 2026-02-23. Omar to create the pre-agg SQL and test on prod-copy by 2026-02-25.

3) Cost telemetry: ingestion pipeline & noisy metrics cleanup
   - Incident recap: recurring spike observed 2026-02-17 03:00 UTC — ingestion costs +22% for the 3h window. Root cause: legacy model-trainer job (train-monitor-legacy) emits per-embedding-dim metrics every sweep (high-cardinality).
   - Mitigation taken: temp kill-switch on the job; cost dropped back to baseline.
   - Next steps: replace per-dim metrics with aggregate summaries; add quota/alert for per-job metric cardinality.
   - Owners: Maya (data-eng) to lead remediation with Infra (ticket JIRA-OBS-812) — estimate: 1 sprint.

4) Alerts & Noise reduction
   - We reduced duplicate alert firing by adjusting grouping keys in the "insecure-connection-rate" alert. Firing count down by ~60%.
   - Still noisy: "heap-growth-suspect" noise during rolling restarts; hypothesis that kube-probes cause transient growth. Action: tune alert to ignore events matching probe-restart tag.

Risks & Questions:
- Will excluding session_id from spans break any debugging flows for customers? Solutions Eng to confirm critical customers before global rollout.
- Are there downstream consumers of per-dim metrics (embeddings) beyond cost telemetry? Data-eng audit in progress.

Action items (owner — due):
- Samir — open instrumentation PR to scrub payload/PII from spans (2026-02-24).
- Li — compatibility note and customer-impact doc for Solutions Eng (2026-02-22).
- Janelle — dashboard migration runbook + rollback plan (2026-02-23).
- Omar — pre-aggregate SQL tests on prod-copy dataset (2026-02-25).
- Maya — lead remediation for train-monitor-legacy metrics (JIRA-OBS-812) (end of sprint).
- Ava — follow up with SRE to schedule a 30m cross-team call re: sampling policy (2026-02-21).

Parking lot / future work:
- Explore low-cost long-term storage tier for raw trace payloads (cost vs. retention tradeoffs).
- Dashboard UX: experiment with lazy-loading detail panels to speed first paint.
- End-to-end test harness for sampling changes (simulate high-cardinality clients).

Notes for docs / comms:
- Draft a short "what changed" blurb for the change to trace sampling to send to #platform-announcements once Solutions Eng signs off.
- Add a FAQ entry in Console docs explaining why some span tags may be absent after scrub (privacy-first rationale).

References / Links:
- JIRA-OBS-789: trace-sampler v2 rollout
- JIRA-OBS-812: train-monitor-legacy metric cleanup
- PR: github.com/redwood-inference/observability/pulls/312 (sampler tests)
- Confluence: OBS telemetry architecture doc (link in metadata)

Meeting wrap: small wins on sampler; clear next steps on dashboards and cost cleanup. Focus next week on finishing the sampler instrumentation PR and validating dashboard pre-aggregates on prod-copy.
